_context.appAccount.actsAs: Field title: which account of the paid app the coworker acts as.
_context.appAccount.appAccount: {app} is the paid app's name (LinkedIn Pro, WhatsApp Pro).
_context.appAccount.wakeWhen: Field title, followed by a list of events (a message arrives, an invitation is accepted...).
_context.authMethod.label.oauth: Name of a way to connect an app: signing in through the app's own page.
_context.authMethod.label.stdio: Name of a way to connect an app: a server that runs on the coworker's own machine.
_context.credentialGuide.title: {label} is the name of the credential as the app calls it ("API key", "secret key"), already lower-cased when it is a common word.
_context.customMcp.custom: Badge of an app server the user added by hand.
_context.configForm.setUp: Title of the step where the user picks the account of a paid app. {name} is the app's name.
_context.installed.nextTurn: {tools} is the list of tool names, separated by commas.
_context.list.needsSetup: Badge of an app installed but not configured yet.
_context.suggestion.notNow: Button that skips connecting this app for now.
_context.suggestion.skipped: State of an app the user chose not to connect.
_context.categories: Filter chips over the catalog of apps a coworker can connect: the kind of app.
